title: Ethiopian Lamb Alicha
community: All of Ethiopia — the mild celebration lamb stew
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Ye-Beg Alicha — young lamb in a mild, golden-yellow stew without berbere, seasoned with turmeric, ginger, and cardamom. The mild celebration counterpart to Ye-Beg Key Wat — served on the same platter for those who prefer no heat.
longDesc: Ye-Beg Alicha is the gentle side of the Ethiopian celebration feast — while the Key Wat burns with berbere, the Alicha provides the golden, mild, cardamom-fragrant counterpoint. Made with the same quality lamb, it is equally prestigious.
steps: Add kibbeh. Add turmeric, ground ginger, cardamom. Stir 1 minute.
Add garlic, fresh ginger, pepper. Cook 2 minutes.
Add water. Simmer covered 75—80 minutes until very tender.
chefTips: No berbere at all — this is genuinely mild.
commonMistakes: Adding berbere — destroys the alicha character.
cookingScience: See ETH027 for alicha cooking science.
servedWith: Alongside Ye-Beg Key Wat on the celebration platter
healthBenefits: Suitable for those who cannot eat chilli.
culturalNote: Ye-Beg Alicha is the thoughtful inclusion on the Ethiopian celebration mesob — the host who serves both a red and a yellow lamb wat has thought of all their guests.
